graph_results.sql:
SELECT productid, name, productnumber, listprice, standardcost
FROM production.product
WHERE TRIM(productline) = 'M'

SELECT color, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM production.product
WHERE color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY color
ORDER BY product_count DESC;
SELECT name FROM production.productcategory;

SELECT productid, name, productnumber, sellenddate
FROM production.product
WHERE sellenddate IS NOT NULL
  AND sellenddate < (SELECT MAX(sellenddate) FROM production.product)
  AND productid NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT productid 
    FROM production.transactionhistory 
    WHERE transactiontype = 'S'
  )
ORDER BY name;

SELECT 
  CASE WHEN makeflag = true THEN 'Manufactured In-House' ELSE 'Purchased' END AS source,
  COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM production.product
GROUP BY makeflag;

SELECT name, costrate
FROM production.location

SELECT scrapreasonid, name
FROM production.scrapreason;

SELECT *
FROM production.product
WHERE weight > 100
  AND TRIM(weightunitmeasurecode) = 'LB'

SELECT ps.name AS subcategory_name, COUNT(p.productid) AS product_count
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
GROUP BY ps.name
ORDER BY ps.name;

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, AVG(p.listprice) AS average_list_price
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
WHERE pc.name IN ('Bikes', 'Clothing', 'Components', 'Accessories')
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY average_list_price DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.location l ON pi.locationid = l.locationid
WHERE l.name = 'Final Assembly'
AND pi.quantity > 0;

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, SUM(pi.quantity) AS total_inventory_quantity
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY pc.name;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name, p.productnumber
FROM production.product p
INNER JOIN production.productlistpricehistory plph ON p.productid = plph.productid
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory h1
    INNER JOIN production.productlistpricehistory h2 ON h1.productid = h2.productid
    WHERE h1.productid = p.productid
      AND h2.startdate > h1.startdate
      AND h2.listprice > h1.listprice
)
ORDER BY p.productid;

SELECT productid, name, listprice
FROM production.product
WHERE TRIM(class) = 'H'
ORDER BY listprice DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pi.shelf, SUM(pi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.location l ON pi.locationid = l.locationid
WHERE l.name = 'Metal Storage'
GROUP BY pi.shelf
ORDER BY pi.shelf;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productreview pr ON pr.productid = p.productid
WHERE pr.rating = 5;

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.productid) AS product_count
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
WHERE p.sellenddate IS NULL
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY pc.name;

SELECT name, productid, listprice, standardcost, (listprice - standardcost) AS margin
FROM production.product
WHERE listprice > 0 AND standardcost > 0
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, AVG(p.daystomanufacture) AS avg_days_to_manufacture
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY pc.name;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.productcosthistory c1
JOIN production.productcosthistory c2 
  ON c1.productid = c2.productid 
  AND c2.startdate > c1.startdate
JOIN production.product p 
  ON p.productid = c1.productid
WHERE c1.standardcost > 0 
  AND (c2.standardcost - c1.standardcost) / c1.standardcost > 0.20;

SELECT 
    pa.name AS assembly_product_name,
    c.name AS component_name,
    bom.perassemblyqty AS quantity_needed,
    bom.bomlevel
FROM production.billofmaterials bom
LEFT JOIN production.product pa ON bom.productassemblyid = pa.productid
JOIN production.product c ON bom.componentid = c.productid
ORDER BY pa.name, bom.bomlevel, c.name;

SELECT 
    l.locationid,
    l.name AS location_name,
    SUM(pi.quantity * p.listprice) AS total_inventory_value
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.location l ON pi.locationid = l.locationid
JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
GROUP BY l.locationid, l.name
ORDER BY l.locationid;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name, p.productnumber
FROM production.product p
INNER JOIN production.billofmaterials bom ON p.productid = bom.componentid
WHERE p.finishedgoodsflag = false;

SELECT 
    ps.name AS subcategory_name,
    SUM(wo.scrappedqty)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(wo.orderqty), 0) AS scrap_rate
FROM production.workorder wo
JOIN production.product p ON wo.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
GROUP BY ps.name
ORDER BY scrap_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    p.productid,
    p.name AS product_name,
    ps.name AS subcategory_name,
    p.listprice,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.productsubcategoryid ORDER BY p.listprice DESC) AS price_rank
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps 
    ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
WHERE p.productsubcategoryid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.name, price_rank;

SELECT 
    p.productid,
    p.name,
    p.listprice,
    p.standardcost,
    CASE WHEN p.standardcost > 0 THEN ((p.listprice - p.standardcost) / p.standardcost) * 100 END AS markup_percentage
FROM production.product p
WHERE p.standardcost > 0
  AND p.listprice > 0
  AND ((p.listprice - p.standardcost) / p.standardcost) * 100 > 200;

SELECT 
    pm.productmodelid,
    pm.name AS model_name,
    COUNT(p.productid) AS product_count,
    pd.description AS english_description
FROM production.productmodel pm
LEFT JOIN production.product p ON p.productmodelid = pm.productmodelid
LEFT JOIN production.productmodelproductdescriptionculture pmpdc 
    ON pmpdc.productmodelid = pm.productmodelid AND TRIM(pmpdc.cultureid) = 'en'
LEFT JOIN production.productdescription pd 
    ON pd.productdescriptionid = pmpdc.productdescriptionid
GROUP BY pm.productmodelid, pm.name, pd.description
ORDER BY pm.productmodelid;

SELECT p.productid, p.name, p.productnumber
FROM production.product p
INNER JOIN production.productinventory pi ON p.productid = pi.productid
GROUP BY p.productid, p.name, p.productnumber
HAVING SUM(pi.quantity) = 0

SELECT
  category_name,
  transaction_month,
  monthly_volume,
  ROUND(AVG(monthly_volume) OVER (
    PARTITION BY category_name
    ORDER BY transaction_month
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ), 2) AS moving_avg_3_month
FROM (
  SELECT
    pc.name AS category_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', th.transactiondate) AS transaction_month,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_volume
  FROM production.transactionhistory th
  JOIN production.product p ON th.productid = p.productid
  JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
  JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
  WHERE th.transactiontype = 'S'
  GROUP BY pc.name, DATE_TRUNC('month', th.transactiondate)
) sub
ORDER BY category_name, transaction_month;

SELECT
    pc.name AS category_name,
    p.name AS product_name,
    wo_stats.total_order_qty,
    wo_stats.scrap_rate,
    wo_stats.avg_actual_routing_cost,
    wo_stats.rn
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.productid,
        p.productsubcategoryid,
        SUM(wo.orderqty) AS total_order_qty,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wo.orderqty) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(SUM(wo.scrappedqty)::numeric / SUM(wo.orderqty) * 100, 2)
            ELSE 0 
        END AS scrap_rate,
        AVG(wor.avg_cost) AS avg_actual_routing_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY psc.productcategoryid 
            ORDER BY SUM(wo.orderqty) DESC
        ) AS rn,
        psc.productcategoryid
    FROM production.workorder wo
    JOIN production.product p ON wo.productid = p.productid
    JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT workorderid, AVG(actualcost) AS avg_cost
        FROM production.workorderrouting
        GROUP BY workorderid
    ) wor ON wor.workorderid = wo.workorderid
    GROUP BY p.productid, p.productsubcategoryid, psc.productcategoryid
) wo_stats
JOIN production.product p ON wo_stats.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON wo_stats.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
WHERE wo_stats.rn <= 5
ORDER BY pc.name, wo_stats.rn;

SELECT 
    p.productid,
    p.name AS product_name,
    pc.name AS category,
    ps.name AS subcategory,
    p.listprice AS current_list_price,
    p.standardcost AS current_standard_cost,
    COALESCE(inv.total_quantity, 0) AS total_inventory_quantity,
    COALESCE(inv.total_quantity, 0) * p.standardcost AS total_inventory_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.listprice > 0 THEN ROUND(((p.listprice - p.standardcost) / p.listprice) * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS profit_margin_percentage
FROM production.product p
LEFT JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT productid, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM production.productinventory
    GROUP BY productid
) inv ON p.productid = inv.productid
WHERE p.sellstartdate IS NOT NULL
    AND p.sellstartdate <= NOW()
    AND (p.sellenddate IS NULL OR p.sellenddate > NOW())
ORDER BY pc.name, ps.name, p.name;

SELECT
    l.name AS location_name,
    pc.name AS category_name,
    SUM(wor.actualcost) AS total_actual_cost,
    SUM(wor.plannedcost) AS total_planned_cost,
    SUM(wor.actualcost) - SUM(wor.plannedcost) AS cost_variance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wor.actualcost) - SUM(wor.plannedcost) DESC) AS overrun_rank
FROM production.workorderrouting wor
JOIN production.location l ON wor.locationid = l.locationid
JOIN production.workorder wo ON wor.workorderid = wo.workorderid
JOIN production.product p ON wo.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY l.name, pc.name
ORDER BY overrun_rank;

SELECT 
    bom.bomlevel,
    assembly.name AS assembly_product_name,
    component.name AS component_product_name,
    SUM(wo.orderqty) AS total_work_order_quantity
FROM production.billofmaterials bom
JOIN production.product component ON bom.componentid = component.productid
LEFT JOIN production.product assembly ON bom.productassemblyid = assembly.productid
JOIN production.workorder wo ON wo.productid = component.productid
GROUP BY bom.bomlevel, assembly.name, component.name
ORDER BY assembly.name, bom.bomlevel, component.name;

SELECT 
    ps.name AS subcategory_name,
    p.name AS product_name,
    first_price.listprice AS first_list_price,
    current_price.listprice AS current_list_price,
    ROUND(((current_price.listprice - first_price.listprice) / first_price.listprice) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_price_change_pct
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN (
    SELECT productid, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory
    GROUP BY productid
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) multi ON multi.productid = p.productid
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT listprice
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory
    WHERE productid = p.productid
    ORDER BY startdate ASC
    LIMIT 1
) first_price ON true
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT listprice
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory
    WHERE productid = p.productid
    ORDER BY startdate DESC
    LIMIT 1
) current_price ON true
WHERE first_price.listprice > 0
ORDER BY ps.name, p.name;

SELECT 
    l.name AS location_name,
    AVG(wor.actualresourcehrs) AS avg_actual_hours,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wor.scheduledenddate - wor.scheduledstartdate)) / 3600) AS avg_scheduled_hours,
    COUNT(*) AS total_operations,
    (
        SELECT pc.name
        FROM production.workorderrouting wor2
        JOIN production.product p2 ON wor2.productid = p2.productid
        JOIN production.productsubcategory psc2 ON p2.productsubcategoryid = psc2.productsubcategoryid
        JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc2.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
        WHERE wor2.locationid = l.locationid
        GROUP BY pc.name
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_common_product_category
FROM production.workorderrouting wor
JOIN production.location l ON wor.locationid = l.locationid
GROUP BY l.locationid, l.name
ORDER BY l.name;

SELECT 
    pc.name AS category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate)::integer AS transaction_year,
    SUM(t.actualcost) AS total_transaction_value,
    SUM(t.actualcost) - LAG(SUM(t.actualcost)) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate)) AS yoy_change,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(SUM(t.actualcost)) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate)) IS NOT NULL 
             AND SUM(t.actualcost) < LAG(SUM(t.actualcost)) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate))
        THEN 'Declining'
        ELSE 'Not Declining'
    END AS trend
FROM (
    SELECT productid, transactiondate, actualcost FROM production.transactionhistory
    UNION ALL
    SELECT productid, transactiondate, actualcost FROM production.transactionhistoryarchive
) t
JOIN production.product p ON t.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate)
ORDER BY pc.name, transaction_year;

SELECT 
    pc.name AS category,
    p.name AS product_name,
    pi_totals.total_stock AS current_stock,
    p.reorderpoint AS reorder_point,
    sr.name AS scrap_reason
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
JOIN (
    SELECT productid, SUM(quantity) AS total_stock
    FROM production.productinventory
    GROUP BY productid
) pi_totals ON pi_totals.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.workorder wo ON wo.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.scrapreason sr ON wo.scrapreasonid = sr.scrapreasonid
WHERE pi_totals.total_stock < p.reorderpoint
  AND p.sellstartdate IS NOT NULL
  AND p.sellenddate IS NULL
  AND wo.scrappedqty > 0
  AND wo.startdate >= ((SELECT MAX(startdate) FROM production.workorder) - INTERVAL '6 months')
GROUP BY pc.name, p.name, pi_totals.total_stock, p.reorderpoint, sr.name
ORDER BY pc.name, p.name, sr.name;

WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.productid, p.name, p.standardcost
    FROM production.product p
    JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
    JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: top-level components of bike assemblies
    SELECT 
        bp.productid AS root_product_id,
        bp.name AS root_product_name,
        bp.standardcost AS root_standard_cost,
        bom.componentid,
        bom.productassemblyid,
        bom.bomlevel,
        bom.perassemblyqty,
        bom.perassemblyqty AS cumulative_qty,
        pc.name AS component_name,
        pc.standardcost AS component_cost
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN production.billofmaterials bom ON bom.productassemblyid = bp.productid
        AND bom.enddate IS NULL
    JOIN production.product pc ON bom.componentid = pc.productid
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: sub-components
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        be.root_product_name,
        be.root_standard_cost,
        bom.componentid,
        bom.productassemblyid,
        bom.bomlevel,
        bom.perassemblyqty,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.perassemblyqty AS cumulative_qty,
        pc.name AS component_name,
        pc.standardcost AS component_cost
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN production.billofmaterials bom ON bom.productassemblyid = be.componentid
        AND bom.enddate IS NULL
    JOIN production.product pc ON bom.componentid = pc.productid
)
SELECT 
    root_product_id,
    root_product_name,
    root_standard_cost,
    componentid,
    component_name,
    bomlevel,
    perassemblyqty,
    cumulative_qty,
    ROUND(cumulative_qty * component_cost, 4) AS total_cost_contribution,
    CASE 
        WHEN root_standard_cost > 0 
        THEN ROUND((cumulative_qty * component_cost / root_standard_cost) * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS pct_of_final_product_cost
FROM bom_explosion
ORDER BY root_product_id, bomlevel, component_name;

SELECT *
FROM production.product
WHERE productline = 'M '

SELECT color, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM production.product
WHERE color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY color
ORDER BY product_count DESC;
SELECT name FROM production.productcategory;
SELECT * FROM production.product WHERE listprice > 1000;

SELECT productid, name, productnumber, sellenddate
FROM production.product
WHERE sellenddate IS NOT NULL
  AND sellenddate < (SELECT MAX(sellenddate) FROM production.product)
  AND productid NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT productid FROM production.transactionhistory WHERE transactiontype = 'S'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT productid FROM production.transactionhistoryarchive WHERE transactiontype = 'S'
  )
ORDER BY name;

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN makeflag = true THEN 'Manufactured In-House' ELSE 'Purchased' END AS source,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM production.product
GROUP BY makeflag
ORDER BY product_count DESC;
SELECT name, costrate FROM production.location

SELECT DISTINCT sr.scrapreasonid, sr.name
FROM production.scrapreason sr
INNER JOIN production.workorder wo ON sr.scrapreasonid = wo.scrapreasonid
WHERE wo.scrappedqty > 0
ORDER BY sr.scrapreasonid;

SELECT *
FROM production.product
WHERE weight > 100 AND weightunitmeasurecode = 'LB '

SELECT *
FROM production.product
WHERE size IN ('L', 'XL')

SELECT psc.name AS subcategory_name, COUNT(p.productid) AS product_count
FROM production.productsubcategory psc
LEFT JOIN production.product p ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
GROUP BY psc.name
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

SELECT pc.name AS category, AVG(p.listprice) AS avg_list_price
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY avg_list_price DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productinventory pi ON p.productid = pi.productid
JOIN production.location l ON pi.locationid = l.locationid
WHERE l.name = 'Final Assembly'
AND pi.quantity > 0
ORDER BY p.name;

SELECT pc.name AS product_category, SUM(pi.quantity) AS total_inventory_quantity
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY total_inventory_quantity DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.product p
INNER JOIN production.productlistpricehistory h1 ON p.productid = h1.productid
INNER JOIN production.productlistpricehistory h2 ON h1.productid = h2.productid
WHERE h2.startdate > h1.startdate
  AND h2.listprice > h1.listprice
ORDER BY p.productid;

SELECT productid, name, productnumber, listprice, color
FROM production.product
WHERE class = 'H '
ORDER BY listprice DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pi.shelf, SUM(pi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.location l ON pi.locationid = l.locationid
WHERE l.name ILIKE 'Metal Storage'
GROUP BY pi.shelf
ORDER BY pi.shelf;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productreview pr ON p.productid = pr.productid
WHERE pr.rating = 5

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
WHERE p.sellenddate IS NULL
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

SELECT productid, name, listprice, standardcost, (listprice - standardcost) AS margin
FROM production.product
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, AVG(p.daystomanufacture) AS avg_days_to_manufacture
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY pc.name;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.productcosthistory pch1
JOIN production.productcosthistory pch2 
    ON pch1.productid = pch2.productid 
    AND pch2.startdate > pch1.startdate
JOIN production.product p 
    ON p.productid = pch1.productid
WHERE pch2.standardcost > pch1.standardcost * 1.20

SELECT 
    pa.name AS assembly_product_name,
    pc.name AS component_name,
    bom.perassemblyqty AS quantity_needed,
    bom.bomlevel
FROM production.billofmaterials bom
LEFT JOIN production.product pa ON bom.productassemblyid = pa.productid
JOIN production.product pc ON bom.componentid = pc.productid
ORDER BY pa.name, bom.bomlevel, pc.name;

SELECT 
    l.locationid,
    l.name AS location_name,
    SUM(pi.quantity * p.listprice) AS total_inventory_value
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.location l ON pi.locationid = l.locationid
GROUP BY l.locationid, l.name
ORDER BY l.locationid;

SELECT DISTINCT p.productid, p.name, p.productnumber
FROM production.product p
INNER JOIN production.billofmaterials bom ON p.productid = bom.componentid
WHERE p.finishedgoodsflag = false

SELECT 
    psc.name AS product_subcategory,
    SUM(wo.scrappedqty)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(wo.orderqty), 0) AS scrap_rate
FROM production.workorder wo
JOIN production.product p ON wo.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
GROUP BY psc.name
ORDER BY scrap_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    p.productid,
    p.name AS product_name,
    psc.name AS subcategory_name,
    p.listprice,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.productsubcategoryid ORDER BY p.listprice DESC) AS price_rank
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc 
    ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
WHERE p.productsubcategoryid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY psc.name, price_rank;

SELECT productid, name, standardcost, listprice,
       CASE WHEN standardcost > 0 THEN ((listprice - standardcost) / standardcost * 100) END AS markup_percentage
FROM production.product
WHERE standardcost > 0
  AND (listprice - standardcost) / standardcost > 2

SELECT 
    pm.productmodelid,
    pm.name AS product_model_name,
    COUNT(p.productid) AS product_count,
    pd.description AS english_description
FROM production.productmodel pm
LEFT JOIN production.product p ON p.productmodelid = pm.productmodelid
LEFT JOIN production.productmodelproductdescriptionculture pmpdc 
    ON pmpdc.productmodelid = pm.productmodelid 
    AND pmpdc.cultureid = 'en    '
LEFT JOIN production.productdescription pd 
    ON pd.productdescriptionid = pmpdc.productdescriptionid
GROUP BY pm.productmodelid, pm.name, pd.description
ORDER BY pm.productmodelid

SELECT p.productid, p.name
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productinventory pi ON p.productid = pi.productid
GROUP BY p.productid, p.name
HAVING SUM(pi.quantity) = 0

SELECT
  category_name,
  transaction_month,
  monthly_volume,
  ROUND(AVG(monthly_volume) OVER (
    PARTITION BY category_name
    ORDER BY transaction_month
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ), 2) AS moving_avg_3_month
FROM (
  SELECT
    pc.name AS category_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', th.transactiondate) AS transaction_month,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_volume
  FROM production.transactionhistory th
  JOIN production.product p ON th.productid = p.productid
  JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
  JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
  WHERE th.transactiontype = 'S'
  GROUP BY pc.name, DATE_TRUNC('month', th.transactiondate)
) sub
ORDER BY category_name, transaction_month

SELECT
    pc.name AS category_name,
    p.name AS product_name,
    t.total_order_qty,
    t.scrap_rate,
    t.avg_actual_cost
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.productid,
        p.productsubcategoryid,
        SUM(wo.orderqty) AS total_order_qty,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wo.orderqty) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(SUM(wo.scrappedqty)::NUMERIC / SUM(wo.orderqty) * 100, 2)
            ELSE 0 
        END AS scrap_rate,
        AVG(wor.actualcost) AS avg_actual_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY psc.productcategoryid 
            ORDER BY SUM(wo.orderqty) DESC
        ) AS rn,
        psc.productcategoryid
    FROM production.workorder wo
    JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = wo.productid
    JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid
    LEFT JOIN production.workorderrouting wor ON wor.workorderid = wo.workorderid AND wor.productid = wo.productid
    GROUP BY p.productid, p.productsubcategoryid, psc.productcategoryid
) t
JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = t.productid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = t.productcategoryid
WHERE t.rn <= 5
ORDER BY pc.name, t.total_order_qty DESC;

SELECT 
    p.name AS product_name,
    pc.name AS category,
    psc.name AS subcategory,
    p.listprice AS current_list_price,
    p.standardcost AS current_standard_cost,
    COALESCE(inv.total_quantity, 0) AS total_inventory_quantity,
    COALESCE(inv.total_quantity, 0) * p.standardcost AS total_inventory_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.listprice > 0 THEN ROUND(((p.listprice - p.standardcost) / p.listprice) * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS profit_margin_percentage
FROM production.product p
LEFT JOIN production.productsubcategory psc 
    ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN production.productcategory pc 
    ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT productid, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM production.productinventory
    GROUP BY productid
) inv ON p.productid = inv.productid
WHERE p.sellenddate IS NULL
ORDER BY profit_margin_percentage DESC;

SELECT
    l.name AS location_name,
    pc.name AS product_category,
    SUM(wor.actualcost) AS total_actual_cost,
    SUM(wor.plannedcost) AS total_planned_cost,
    SUM(wor.actualcost) - SUM(wor.plannedcost) AS cost_variance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wor.actualcost) - SUM(wor.plannedcost) DESC) AS overrun_rank
FROM production.workorderrouting wor
JOIN production.location l ON wor.locationid = l.locationid
JOIN production.product p ON wor.productid = p.productid
LEFT JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY l.name, pc.name
ORDER BY overrun_rank, l.name, pc.name

SELECT 
    bom.bomlevel,
    assembly.name AS assembly_product_name,
    SUM(wo.orderqty) AS total_work_order_quantity
FROM production.billofmaterials bom
JOIN production.product component ON bom.componentid = component.productid
JOIN production.product assembly ON bom.productassemblyid = assembly.productid
JOIN production.workorder wo ON wo.productid = component.productid
GROUP BY bom.bomlevel, assembly.name
ORDER BY assembly.name, bom.bomlevel;

SELECT 
    psc.name AS subcategory_name,
    p.productid,
    p.name AS product_name,
    first_price.listprice AS first_listprice,
    current_price.listprice AS current_listprice,
    ROUND(((current_price.listprice - first_price.listprice) / first_price.listprice) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_price_change_pct
FROM production.product p
INNER JOIN production.productsubcategory psc 
    ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT productid
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory
    GROUP BY productid
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) multi ON p.productid = multi.productid
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (productid) productid, listprice
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory
    ORDER BY productid, startdate ASC
) first_price ON p.productid = first_price.productid
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (productid) productid, listprice
    FROM production.productlistpricehistory
    ORDER BY productid, startdate DESC
) current_price ON p.productid = current_price.productid
WHERE first_price.listprice > 0
ORDER BY psc.name, cumulative_price_change_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    l.name AS location_name,
    AVG(wor.actualresourcehrs) AS avg_actual_hours,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wor.scheduledenddate - wor.scheduledstartdate)) / 3600) AS avg_scheduled_hours,
    (SELECT pc.name
     FROM production.workorderrouting wor2
     JOIN production.product p2 ON wor2.productid = p2.productid
     JOIN production.productsubcategory psc2 ON p2.productsubcategoryid = psc2.productsubcategoryid
     JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc2.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
     WHERE wor2.locationid = l.locationid
     GROUP BY pc.name
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
     LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_common_product_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_operations
FROM production.workorderrouting wor
JOIN production.location l ON wor.locationid = l.locationid
GROUP BY l.locationid, l.name
ORDER BY l.name;

SELECT 
    pc.name AS category_name,
    yr,
    total_value,
    LAG(total_value) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY yr) AS prev_year_value,
    total_value - LAG(total_value) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY yr) AS yoy_change,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(total_value) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY yr) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(((total_value - LAG(total_value) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY yr)) / LAG(total_value) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY yr)) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS yoy_change_pct,
    CASE 
        WHEN total_value < LAG(total_value) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.name ORDER BY yr) 
        THEN 'Declining'
        ELSE 'Not Declining'
    END AS trend
FROM (
    SELECT 
        t.productid,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate) AS yr,
        SUM(t.actualcost * t.quantity) AS total_value
    FROM (
        SELECT productid, transactiondate, actualcost, quantity
        FROM production.transactionhistory
        UNION ALL
        SELECT productid, transactiondate, actualcost, quantity
        FROM production.transactionhistoryarchive
    ) t
    GROUP BY t.productid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transactiondate)
) tv
JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = tv.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = psc.productcategoryid
GROUP BY pc.name, yr
ORDER BY pc.name, yr;

SELECT 
    p.name AS product_name,
    pc.name AS category,
    SUM(pi.quantity) AS current_stock,
    p.reorderpoint,
    sr.name AS scrap_reason
FROM production.product p
JOIN production.productinventory pi ON pi.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid
JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = psc.productcategoryid
JOIN production.workorder wo ON wo.productid = p.productid
JOIN production.scrapreason sr ON sr.scrapreasonid = wo.scrapreasonid
WHERE p.sellenddate IS NULL
  AND wo.scrappedqty > 0
  AND wo.startdate >= ((SELECT MAX(startdate) FROM production.workorder) - INTERVAL '6 months')
GROUP BY p.productid, p.name, pc.name, p.reorderpoint, sr.name
HAVING SUM(pi.quantity) < p.reorderpoint
ORDER BY p.name, sr.name;

WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.productid, p.name, p.standardcost
    FROM production.product p
    JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid
    JOIN production.productcategory pc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base level: direct components of bike assemblies
    SELECT 
        bp.productid AS root_product_id,
        bp.name AS root_product_name,
        bp.standardcost AS root_product_cost,
        bom.componentid,
        comp.name AS component_name,
        bom.bomlevel,
        bom.perassemblyqty,
        bom.perassemblyqty AS cumulative_qty,
        comp.standardcost AS component_cost,
        bom.perassemblyqty * comp.standardcost AS total_cost_contribution
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN production.billofmaterials bom ON bom.productassemblyid = bp.productid
        AND bom.enddate IS NULL
    JOIN production.product comp ON bom.componentid = comp.productid
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of components
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        be.root_product_name,
        be.root_product_cost,
        bom.componentid,
        comp.name AS component_name,
        bom.bomlevel,
        bom.perassemblyqty,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.perassemblyqty AS cumulative_qty,
        comp.standardcost AS component_cost,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.perassemblyqty * comp.standardcost AS total_cost_contribution
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN production.billofmaterials bom ON bom.productassemblyid = be.componentid
        AND bom.enddate IS NULL
    JOIN production.product comp ON bom.componentid = comp.productid
)
SELECT 
    root_product_name,
    root_product_cost,
    bomlevel,
    component_name,
    perassemblyqty,
    cumulative_qty,
    component_cost,
    ROUND(total_cost_contribution, 4) AS total_cost_contribution,
    CASE 
        WHEN root_product_cost > 0 THEN ROUND((total_cost_contribution / root_product_cost) * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS pct_of_final_product_cost
FROM bom_explosion
ORDER BY root_product_name, bomlevel, component_name;
